rulings.raw: 2 bell peppers ((we use 1 red and 1 green))
rulings.evidence: bell-peppers is a live board id at 5 of 7 stores, so this is a REUSE and only the vocabulary row is missing. Refused green-bell-pepper: the line is deliberately one red and one green, and green-only pricing is the standing rejection.

Either-or line; took the first-named turkey, and ground-turkey is a live board id at 7 of 7 (cheapest 2.66 at Aldi) so this is a reuse, not a proposal. Not bridged to ground-beef-8020: different meat, different price class.

A bag of shredded cheese is the purchased product, and shredded-cheese is the board's own 7 of 7 match - the same call as the 2026-08-26 'shredded mozzarella cheese' ruling. Kept as mapped rather than mapped-optional because the source's own published macros include it.

rulings.evidence: Exact same-form vocabulary row Refrigerated Biscuits [refrigerated-biscuits], board 7 of 7; halved is a knife cut, not a form flip. Weighed at 58 g per biscuit (16.3 oz / 8 ct Grands can).
